textual.observation: The title presents OneCoin as a "Powerful Opportunity," while the description directs viewers to register through a supplied OneCoin signup URL.

evidence.quote: OneCoin New Crypto Currency Powerful Opportunity Review

textual.context: The description explicitly presents the content as sponsored and uses promotional registration language; the source records do not establish whether the title's opportunity framing is endorsed, quoted, or independently reviewed.
textual.potential_relevance: A claimed opportunity and stated sponsorship/affiliation are linked to a requested registration action through the supplied signup destination, creating a relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish any promised return, payment, required personal information, transaction outcome, identity verification, or whether the supplied destination is legitimate.

visual.observation: A webpage repeatedly promotes OneCoin as a cryptocurrency and "online make money opportunity," with claims that members can make profits and that the currency's value increases over time.
visual.context: Promotional webpage content; the material presents OneCoin as a cryptocurrency and associates it with money-making and growth claims.
visual.potential_relevance: The observed promotional claims link alleged financial returns and value growth to joining or purchasing the promoted cryptocurrency opportunity.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish whether the claims are accurate, whether any money was paid or received, or the identity or status of the promoter.

visual.observation: The webpage repeatedly displays "Register Now!" and "Register Free Today!" alongside a visible Blogspot URL directing viewers to the OneCoin-related site.
visual.context: Repeated call-to-action graphics and the displayed destination appear within promotional webpage content.
visual.potential_relevance: The material links a registration request and external destination to the promoted cryptocurrency and money-making opportunity.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show whether the URL was clicked, what the destination contained beyond the visible address, or whether registration required payment or data submission.

visual.observation: The product-line text describes packages with different prices, including a Trader package requiring at least 500 EUR, a Pro Trader package costing 3000 EUR, and a Tycoon Trader package costing 5000 EUR; it also mentions an activation kit price.
visual.context: The amounts and package conditions are presented as part of promotional product-line text.
visual.potential_relevance: The observed paid package tiers and activation requirement are linked to obtaining tokens, online education, and trader-related benefits.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish the payment recipient, payment method, whether the prices were current, or whether any purchaser received the described benefits.

visual.observation: The text says members can use two cryptocurrencies, Aurum Gold and OneCoins, and states that the program includes an "amusing bonus program" from which members may get rewards.
visual.context: The statements appear in promotional explanatory text about joining and participating in the program.
visual.potential_relevance: The described bonus and cryptocurrency benefits are presented in connection with becoming a member of the program.
visual.limitations: The frame does not specify the bonus amount, eligibility details, payout conditions, or whether rewards were actually provided.

visual.observation: The webpage claims that the "One Life" program provides vouchers redeemable for luxury restaurants, hotels, holidays, and other benefits, and encourages viewers to make sure they join the program before taking advantage of it.
visual.context: Promotional text describing a membership-related lifestyle and voucher program.
visual.potential_relevance: The promised vouchers and benefits are linked to joining the program, with wording encouraging enrollment before access to the stated benefits.
visual.limitations: The frame does not show voucher issuance, redemption, eligibility requirements, costs, deadlines, or actual outcomes.

visual.observation: Promotional text states that OneCoin has become one with OPN, identifies Dr. Ruja Ignatova as CEO, and claims that the companies have a large network, global clients and teams, and many members making profits.
visual.context: The affiliation, leadership, network, and profit statements are presented as promotional claims alongside OneCoin branding.
visual.potential_relevance: The claimed company affiliation and leadership are coupled with assertions about scale and member profits, which may affect how viewers assess the opportunity.
visual.limitations: The frames do not independently verify the affiliation, identity, number of members, or reported profits.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as a cryptocurrency and online money-making opportunity using claims of increasing value, trading profits, and member profits. It urges viewers to register through a stated destination, offers paid package tiers from at least 500 EUR to 5000 EUR, and presents a 1,100-dollar coin purchase as an action to take, although the material does not establish whether any payment, registration, or promised outcome occurred.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The page directly links a proposed coin purchase to its claim that digital-currency value increases over time.

evidence.observation: The description presents a sponsored signup link and a free-registration request.
The page says digital-currency value increases over time and urges spending at least $1,100 to purchase a coin.
A registration graphic appears with a Blogspot address and the words 'Register Free Today!'
The product-line page describes online education and trader packages, tokens received with package purchases, and package prices in EUR.
The page claims a training program can help beginners enjoy profit from digital currency and describes unlimited income through cryptocurrency trading.
